description: Sale-side variant wiring on mobile + web, and kiosk exclusion. Migrates POSSaleScreen and WebPOSScreen from their inline toCartProduct copies to the shared FEAT-001 helper, adds a VariantSelector (mobile modal + web inline modal, implemented twice per house style), inserts the variant branch into tap + barcode handlers with correct precedence, shows masterDisplayStock in grids, and filters variant products out of kiosk. Depends on FEAT-001 (shared toCartProduct, variant types, findProductByBarcode variant?, masterDisplayStock). Integration/manual-verified (RN render) plus lint.
steps: src/components/sale/VariantSelector.tsx (NEW, mobile): modal mirroring the existing UOMSelector (POSSaleScreen line 77) / StaffPopup pattern using Colors/Spacing/Typography tokens. Props interface `{ visible: boolean; master: ProductMaster; branchId?: string; onSelect: (cartProduct: Product, variant: ProductVariant) => void; onClose: () => void }`. Render master.options to pick one value per option, resolve the matching master.variants[] entry by optionValues, build the cart line via shared toCartProduct(master, master.uoms[0], branchId, variant). Thai labels; empty/disabled state if no variant matches.

src/screens/sale/POSSaleScreen.tsx: remove the inline toCartProduct (line 43) and import { toCartProduct, masterDisplayStock } from '../../utils/cartProduct'. In handleProductPress (line 444) set precedence: service (unchanged) -> `master.variants?.length` (setSelectedMaster + open new showVariantSelector) -> multi-UOM picker (unchanged) -> default add. Mirror in handleProductLongPress. In handleScan (line 477) use findProductByBarcode result: if result.variant present addItem(toCartProduct(result.product, result.uom, activeBranchId, result.variant)); else if the matched product has variants (non-variant/uom barcode) open VariantSelector; else existing path. Render the mobile <VariantSelector> near the existing <UOMSelector> (line 776). Grids: display masterDisplayStock(master) for variant products.

src/screens/web/WebPOSScreen.tsx: remove inline toCartProduct (line 126) and import shared { toCartProduct, masterDisplayStock }. Add a web variant-picker Modal mirroring the UOM Picker Modal (~line 3216) using WebColors tokens, driven by a new `variantPickerProduct`/master state. In BOTH grid onPress (~2247) and list onPress (~2294) blocks, after computing `master`, insert: if `master?.variants?.length` open the variant modal (takes precedence over the UOM picker). Refactor handleBarcodeSubmit (line 1459) to call shared findProductByBarcode(trimmed, masterProducts): if result.variant -> handleProductTap/addItem with toCartProduct(product,uom,activeBranchId,variant); if variant-bearing product matched by non-variant barcode -> open variant modal; else existing keyword-filter fallback. Grids display masterDisplayStock for variant products.

src/screens/kiosk/KioskPOSSaleScreen.tsx: build the grid source from `const KIOSK_PRODUCTS = MOCK_PRODUCTS.filter(m => !(m.variants && m.variants.length));` and use KIOSK_PRODUCTS for ALL_PRODUCTS flatMap AND pass KIOSK_PRODUCTS (not raw MOCK_PRODUCTS) into findProductByBarcode. Leave the kiosk local 2-arg toCartProduct (line 35) untouched; add a one-line comment that kiosk is intentionally out of variant scope.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` reports no type errors across the three screens + new component.
POSSaleScreen and WebPOSScreen no longer declare a local toCartProduct; both import it from src/utils/cartProduct.ts.

FEAT-001 unit suite still passes unchanged (no behavioral regression to shared helpers): `npx vitest run src/utils src/store/__tests__/productStore.test.ts src/store/__tests__/categoryStore.test.ts src/data src/engine/adapter/__tests__/cartAdapter.test.ts`.
Tap/barcode precedence implemented: service -> variant -> multi-UOM -> default; variant-bearing products are absent from the kiosk grid and kiosk barcode match.
verification: npx vitest run src/utils src/store/__tests__/productStore.test.ts src/store/__tests__/categoryStore.test.ts src/data src/engine/adapter/__tests__/cartAdapter.test.ts
findings:
LANDED (feat/vmat worktree, committed locally, NOT pushed).

WHAT CHANGED:
- src/components/sale/VariantSelector.tsx (NEW, mobile): bottom-sheet modal mirroring ServiceStaffPopup/UOMSelector. Props `{ visible; master: ProductMaster | null; branchId?; onSelect(cartProduct, variant); onClose }`. User picks one value per option chip; resolves the matching master.variants[] entry by optionValues (helper findMatchingVariant), builds the cart line via shared toCartProduct(master, master.uoms[0], branchId, variant). Thai labels, 44px touch targets (ComponentSize.button.md), price preview via resolveCartPrice, disabled/empty state when no variant matches ('ไม่มีสินค้าตามตัวเลือกที่เลือก' / 'ไม่มีข้อมูลตัวเลือก'). Confirm button disabled until a variant matches.
- src/screens/sale/POSSaleScreen.tsx: removed inline toCartProduct; now imports { toCartProduct, masterDisplayStock } from ../../utils/cartProduct and VariantSelector. Added state showVariantSelector/variantMaster. handleProductPress precedence service -> variant (master.variants?.length) -> multi-UOM -> default; mirrored in handleProductLongPress (variant -> UOM -> add). handleScan: result.variant => addItem(toCartProduct(...,variant)); else result.product.variants?.length => open VariantSelector; else existing path; else not-found. Renders <VariantSelector> next to <UOMSelector>. Grid renderProduct uses displayStock = variants?.length ? masterDisplayStock(master) : item.stockQty for out/low-stock badges + disabled/press guards. Removed now-unused ProductUOM import.
- src/screens/web/WebPOSScreen.tsx: removed inline toCartProduct; imports shared { toCartProduct, masterDisplayStock } + findProductByBarcode (dropped MOCK_PRODUCTS/ProductUOM imports; kept resolveCartPrice for variant price preview; swapped ProductUOM import for ProductMaster/ProductVariant). Added state variantPickerMaster/variantSelected. handleBarcodeSubmit refactored to shared findProductByBarcode(trimmed, masterProducts): result.variant -> handleProductTap(toCartProduct(...,variant)); variant-bearing product by non-variant barcode -> open variant modal; else existing resolve; else keyword fallback. BOTH grid onPress (converted the .map arrow to a block to compute master/dStock) and list onPress: if master?.variants?.length open variant modal (precedence over UOM picker). New web Variant Picker Modal mirrors the UOM Picker Modal with WebColors/m.* styles (option chips, price preview, 'เพิ่มลงบิล'/ 'ยกเลิก', empty + no-match warn states). Grids display dStock = variants?.length ? masterDisplayStock : p.stockQty.
- src/screens/kiosk/KioskPOSSaleScreen.tsx: added const KIOSK_PRODUCTS = MOCK_PRODUCTS.filter(m => !(m.variants && m.variants.length)); ALL_PRODUCTS flatMap now uses KIOSK_PRODUCTS, the `filtered` unit-lookup uses KIOSK_PRODUCTS, and handleScan passes KIOSK_PRODUCTS into findProductByBarcode (so variant p30 is absent from grid AND barcode match). Kiosk local 2-arg toCartProduct left untouched with an added comment that kiosk is intentionally out of variant scope.

FOR FEAT-003 (authoring): VariantSelector is sale-side only (reads master.options/variants). Authoring screens (AddEditProductScreen/WebProductScreen/CategoryManageScreen etc.) were NOT touched. The mobile VariantSelector and the web variant modal are implemented separately (house split, like UOM selectors) — reuse these as the sale-side reference, not a shared component.

VERIFICATION: `npm run lint` => 13 errors, ALL pre-existing baseline (BranchSelector/DatePicker/PermissionMatrixScreen/RoleManageScreen/WebUserStaffScreen/errorTracking) — ZERO in the touched files. `npx vitest run src/utils src/store/__tests__/productStore.test.ts src/store/__tests__/categoryStore.test.ts src/data src/engine/adapter/__tests__/cartAdapter.test.ts` => 6 files / 43 tests passed, unchanged.
